manifest.name: dsh-git-workflow
manifest.description: Git workflow tools for DeepSeek Harness: conventional commits, changelog generation, PR summaries, and pushes — GitCode / GitHub / any git remote.

bundle.text:
# dsh-git-workflow bundle patch: conventional git workflow tools.
#
# Registers model-visible tools (no external CLI or API required beyond git):
#   - git_status     : branch / ahead-behind / staged files / recent commits
#   - git_commit     : conventional-commit message validation + commit
#   - git_changelog  : markdown changelog grouped by conventional type
#   - git_pr_summary : PR title/description skeleton from a base..head range
#   - git_push       : push the current branch to a remote
#
# Configuration (via the profile's cordis.patch.yml or --patch overlays):
#   - id: git-workflow
#     config:
#       enabled: true
#       workdir: ''            # optional; defaults to the session workspace
#       conventional: true     # enforce Conventional Commits on git_commit
#       defaultBranch: main    # assumed PR base when base is omitted

- insert:
    - id: git-workflow
      name: 'dsh-git-workflow'
      inject: [tools]

readme.text: DeepSeek Harness Git 工作流插件：规范提交（Conventional Commits）、自动 changelog、PR 描述生成、分支推送——纯 `git` CLI，兼容 GitCode / GitHub / 任何 git 远端，无需平台 API 或 token。

readme.section: 或从本地 checkout 安装

readme.text:
```yaml
- id: git-workflow
  config:
    enabled: true
    workdir: ''        # 可选；默认会话工作目录

readme.section: 工具（对话中自动调用，无需命令）
readme.text:
| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `git_status` | 分支 / 与上游领先落后 / 已暂存·未暂存·未跟踪文件 / 最近提交 |
| `git_commit` | 校验 Conventional Commits 格式（`feat|fix|docs|…(scope)?: subject`，破坏性变更加 `!`），可选 `all=true` 先暂存全部再提交 |
| `git_changelog` | 生成按类型分组的 Markdown 变更日志；`from` 默认最近 tag |
| `git_pr_summary` | 生成 PR 标题建议 + 描述模板（提交列表 / diff 统计 / 破坏性变更） |
| `git_push` | `git push -u <remote> <branch>` 推送并设置上游 |

示例对话：

readme.section: 工具（对话中自动调用，无需命令）
readme.text:
```
我：帮我把这次改动提交了
Agent：git_status → 发现 3 个文件变更 → git_commit message="feat: add login flow"
我：生成一个 PR 描述
Agent：git_pr_summary base=main → 输出可直接粘贴的 Markdown

```sh
pnpm install && pnpm build
node test/git-workflow.test.mjs   # 临时仓库端到端：状态/规范提交/changelog/PR/推送
```
